text:
alicia: Quick sync — EU residency question for the new eu-west-5 region. We're getting a customer that requires EU-only storage + egress. Any blockers on routing/policy or KMS residency?
priya: Noted. Is this for Hosted or Dedicated? That changes the flow.
alicia: Hosted API initially, may move to Dedicated later. Need to confirm we can pin egress and logs to EU.
miguel: For Hosted, we rely on smart routing + peering configs. Current plan routes traffic to eu-west-3/4 for eu-west-5 until capacity is fully provisioned. Need legal sign-off on logs in eu-west-5.
ben: Who owns the egress ACLs for eu-west-5? I thought infra-net did, pinging @sara infra.
sara: infra-net owns ACLs, but eng-platform owns route policies and residency tags. We need a small change to route policy evaluator to prefer region-local endpoints when residency tag==EU_ONLY.
alicia: That change is fine. Miguel/Ben — estimate for a patch and canary?
miguel: Patch is ~1 day dev + light e2e, canary in staging same day assuming envs available. Removal fallback logic already exists.
ben: Add me as reviewer. I'll split the PR: one for route policy + test, one for infra ACL change.
priya: Also confirm KMS key residency — Private deployment uses customer KMS, Hosted uses our regional KMS. Legal needs guarantee KMS in EU. Kai, can you confirm KMS availability in eu-west-5?
kai: KMS is available but it's a new HSM-backed keyring; ops-bot will post status snapshot.
ops-bot: [auto] KMS eu-west-5: provisioning complete. SLA: 99.99%. Key rotation enabled. Snapshot: https://internal.kms/status/eu-west-5
alicia: Great. Two blockers then: legal sign-off for hosted log residency and infra ACL change scheduling.
sara: I'll coordinate infra ACLs. Ben — can you open infra ticket w/ required IP ranges and retention policy?
ben: On it, ticket #INF-8432. Will link here when created.
miguel: I'll open the PR for route policy change: draft PR -> run e2e -> request review from @ben and @priya.
priya: Sounds good. Also add a small smoke test that simulates residency-tagged requests (we had a bug last time where cache routing bypassed tag).
alicia: Important — timeline: customer expects test account by EOD Friday. Can we hit that?
kai: If PR lands by Wed EOD and infra ticket is scheduled Thu, staging smoke Fri morning should be doable.
sara: I'll reserve maintenance window Thu 03:00-05:00 UTC for the ACL change to minimize impact.
ben: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/route-policy/pulls/512 — draft includes residency flag and unit tests.
miguel: Running CI now. If green I'll move to review.
priya: I'll add smoke test to the e2e suite this afternoon.
alicia: Thanks team. I'll update customer to expect Friday staging invite and keep legal on the log residency thread.
ben: INF-8432 created: https://tracker/internal/INF-8432 — describes IPs, CIDR, retention: 30d, EU-only storage.
sara: ACK. Scheduling note added.
priya: Quick note: ensure metrics/alerting tag includes "residency=eu_only" so oncall can triage special-cased traffic.
miguel: Will add metric and dashboard tile: "residency.e2e.latency".
alicia: Closing loop — next steps: Ben infra ticket, Miguel PR, Priya e2e, Sara schedule ACL. Ping here when done. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: [reminder] 4187654321 — follow-up ping in 24h for pending items.
